## Advisor angle
If the Fed keeps raising rates, advisors may need to revisit clients' bond holdings, floating-rate debt, and expectations for stocks. Clients who see the Dow drop may need reassurance about their long-term plan.

## Term of the day: Half-point hike
A half-point hike raises the Fed's target rate by 0.50 percentage points (50 basis points), double the usual 0.25-point step. It signals urgency about inflation.

## Interview talking point
"The Fed is debating whether to raise rates by a larger-than-usual half point, so I'd want to know how clients' bond and borrowing exposure holds up if that happens."
